items.q: So he said, "Well, I'll teach you what you need to know." So he taught me, like, "Dinah" and "Sweet Sue"

ctx.x: okay." I said, "I don't know no music, though." So he said, "Well, I'll teach you what you need to know." So he taught me, like, "Dinah" and "Sweet Sue" and numbers like that, something easy that I could play.
And we went on this carnival, and we went up to...we went back to Bristow. I had learned how to play the trumpet, you know, enough to do the tunes at least.
